theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Professional corporate (JP Morgan style) demands authority, clarity, and a function-first approach. We avoid generic SaaS styles and instead use a stark, highly legible Swiss grid system with deep Obsidian and stark Whites. We use Archetype 4 for precise data density and sharp contrast, perfect for institutional finance.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Chivo. Keep tracking tight on headings.
rules.overlines: Use small_labels format for chart titles, table headers, and KPI descriptors.

rules.contrast: Always maintain high contrast. Text on dark background must be at least F3F4F6.
rules.accents: Limit vibrant highlights to green/red for profit/loss metrics.
rules.neutral_tint: Dark mode background is not pure black, it's a very deep blue-tinted obsidian.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards to maximize data density. But generous internal padding.

rules.widget_stretch: Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch to match their neighbors. No jagged bottoms.
rules.container: Max-width 100%, full bleed inside the app shell.
rules.padding: Generous internal padding inside widgets (p-6) to prevent text collision with the 1px borders.

rules.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), zero radius (rounded-none) or max 2px. No floating soft shadows. Cardless dashboard preferred (just borders).
rules.headers: Solid background with a hard 1px bottom border. No glassmorphism for finance, it feels too clinical. Pure solid surfaces.
rules.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color darkens on hover for interactive elements.

shadcn_customization.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary button uses primary color, no gradient.
shadcn_customization.inputs: 1px border, background matches surface, sharp focus ring (focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-1 focus:ring-1).
shadcn_customization.tables: Dense. border-collapse style. 1px borders on bottom of every row. Header is small_labels typography.
shadcn_customization.charts: Recharts. Use sharp angles where possible. Monotone or straight line types. Colors match success/danger or primary/muted for generic data. Always format tooltip values as currency.

icons.usage: Use sparingly. Mostly for trend arrows (ArrowUpRight/ArrowDownRight) and sidebar nav.

rules.hover: Explicitly set text color and background on hover (e.g., hover:bg-secondary hover:text-primary).
rules.focus: High contrast focus rings. focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background.
rules.loading: Use sharp, rectangular skeleton blocks with a subtle pulse animation.

login_background.description: Abstract reflective glass facade reflecting the sky, used for the left-side split panel on the login screen to evoke corporate scale.
login_background.overlay: bg-black/40 (if dark mode) or bg-white/20 (if light mode) to maintain corporate feel without obscuring.

page_specific_instructions.login: Split screen layout. Left side: full-height image. Right side: centered auth form, perfectly vertical alignment. Form inputs must be large (h-12) and sharp.
page_specific_instructions.app_shell: Collapsible sidebar on left (border-r border-border). Top header with Dark Mode toggle and User Profile dropdown (border-b border-border).
page_specific_instructions.dashboard: 4 KPI Cards (Total Income, Total Expenses, Net Balance, Transaction Count) at top. Below: Monthly Trends ComposedChart spanning 2 or 3 columns, Category PieChart spanning 1 column. Bottom: Recent Activity table. Use 1px left-border highlights (e.g. border-l-4 border-l-primary) on KPI widgets to ground them.
page_specific_instructions.transactions: Full-width filter bar above the table. Table must be highly scannable with alternating row backgrounds or sharp 1px borders. Status/Type column uses colored text (green/red) rather than heavy pill badges.
page_specific_instructions.users: Admin only table. Clean role badges (small, sharp borders). Toggle switch for active/inactive status.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., login-submit-button, dashboard-total-income-kpi).

file_system.rule: Use .js/.jsx extensions strictly for all files containing React logic/components, NOT .tsx or .ts, as per problem statement requirements.
